title: Particle Methods with Deep Learning for Stochastic Control under Partial Observation
summary: Numerical computation of stochastic control problems under partial observation is challenging because the dynamic programming formulation is naturally posed on the conditional distribution of the hidden state. We propose particle-based methods that replace this infinite-dimensional filtering state by a finite-dimensional weighted particle system, building on recent limit theory for mean-field control with common-noise-adapted controls. We prove, under suitable assumptions, convergence of the fully discretized particle approximation to the original continuous-time partially observed control…
